projects.title: FolioSure
projects.subtitle: Enterprise Portfolio Intelligence Platform
projects.overview: A comprehensive portfolio monitoring and analytics platform serving private equity and venture capital firms. The system aggregates financial data from diverse sources, applies advanced analytics, and generates actionable insights for investment decision-making.
projects.challenge: PE/VC firms struggled with fragmented data sources, manual reporting processes, and lack of real-time portfolio visibility. They needed a unified platform capable of processing complex financial data while maintaining institutional-grade security and compliance.
projects.solution: Architected a cloud-native microservices platform with intelligent data aggregation, automated reporting, and interactive analytics. Implemented AI-powered document processing to extract structured data from unstructured sources, dramatically reducing manual effort.
responsibilities: Led architectural design and technology stack selection for microservices infrastructure
Developed core portfolio analytics engine processing real-time financial data
Implemented AI/ML pipelines for automated document digitization using OCR and NLP
Designed scalable data ingestion system handling multiple data formats and sources
Built interactive BI dashboards with drill-down capabilities and custom visualizations
Established CI/CD pipelines ensuring reliable, automated deployments

keyFeatures.description: Unified data pipeline ingesting financial and operational data from 50+ sources with automated validation and reconciliation
OCR and NLP-based extraction system converting unstructured documents into structured data with 98% accuracy
Flexible calculation framework allowing users to create custom metrics with complex formulas and dependencies
Interactive dashboards with real-time charts, trend analysis, and predictive insights
Template-driven report generation for investor updates, board presentations, and regulatory compliance
Comprehensive ESG data collection and reporting aligned with SFDR, GRI, and SASB standards

technicalHighlights: Microservices architecture with event-driven communication patterns
